sourceComparison.comparisonMethod: Read both complete UTF-8 sources, apply only the listed literal replacements to each old source, and compare the resulting full string case-sensitively with each new source. Read-only SHA-256 and length checks identify the reviewed files.

previousUnexecutedSourceReviews.scope: Original-clock guardian before adding explicit post-owner original-artifact retention verification.

Retention extension required correction before execution: it could invoke a package verifier after incomplete intake and unconditionally labelled verification as after cleanup. The final reviewed version gates execution and records observed cleanup.

sourceControlsReviewed: A previously persisted original-session-budget.json rejects another invocation; the new monotonic tick and UTC start are persisted before intake/source hashing.
The exact source/run/Foundation selection and both reviewed wrapper/intake hashes are checked before starting the sole intake child; the original tick and UTC value are passed unchanged.
Both output streams drain to Stream.Null. The child process cutoff is original second 258, followed by at most one second of owned process-tree termination before the original 260-second maximum.
Forced termination, child failure or an exceeded elapsed allowance leaves Passed false. No retry, clock restart or default-promotion claim is allowed.

Original-artifact verification is admitted only after exact run/revision CleanupComplete and bounded source-bound preparation evidence; the verifier's exact byte length and SHA-256 are checked while a write/delete-denying handle remains open through process exit.

The post-owner native verifier checks the original PQ2 byte length and complete SHA-256 under the same original clock, with a fifteen-second operation bound and original second-258 cutoff. Its VerificationAfterOwnerCleanup flag derives from the actual receipt check.
outerGuardianReview.separateVerdictsRequired: Guardian Passed describes the workload/session exit. Original PQ2 retention requires its own Verified receipt plus independently reviewed detailed cleanup and package identity evidence; neither field alone is a rollback gate verdict.
outerGuardianReview.receiptTimingBoundary: Guardian ElapsedSeconds is captured immediately before final result serialization/write. Retained result and archival completion must also be attributed to the original monotonic clock when reviewing total charged time.

sourceControlsReviewed: Exact settled-main commit, successful exact-source Foundation, successful hosted preparation, one queued owner job and only its run-specific label are checked before registration.
Retained archive, all three exact members, receipt, two native ARM64 binaries, compiler identity and official runner listener are checked against explicit reviewed identities.
An existing Bonsai, model, speech or runner process, existing runner credential or preexisting repository runner registration rejects admission without stopping that user session.
An independent watchdog observes the same externally supplied monotonic clock; intake, runtime-only provisioning, registration, model work, cleanup and retention retain their original deadlines.
Cleanup targets recorded PID plus creation-time identities and this wrapper's unique registration; registration secrets remain environment-only and raw native/token-bearing output is suppressed.
knownUnchangedLimitations: Some trusted API and process-output bounds are checked after ReadToEndAsync; this review does not claim strict preallocation bounds for those trusted intake paths.
Synchronous hashing/provisioning operations rely on outer ownership/watchdog controls rather than immediate cooperative preemption.
Pretrial source review proves no live admission, model execution, completion, isolation, cleanup or promotion gate. Actual retained receipts and independent execution review are still required.
